widgets_values: Wide-angle photorealistic nature video, locked-off static camera, no camera movement. A mossy rock gorge with a dark cave on the left, a tall thin waterfall in the back and a clear turquoise pool below. At first the waterfall flows normally and the pool ripples gently. Then the waterfall swells and pours much harder, and a thick torrent of clear water bursts out of the dark cave mouth and gushes into the pool. The pool churns with white foam, waves roll outward across the surface and splash against the boulders at the edge. Toward the end the torrent eases and the water returns to a steady, natural flow, while the waterfall keeps falling. The water is clear and liquid with sharp detailed ripples, spray and foam that follow the flow. The rocks, cliffs, cave, trees and sky stay perfectly still. Sound: roaring rush of water echoing from the cave, heavy waterfall splash.
